gen-gf-bellota-text-switzer: Switzer is a plain sans with wire-like, tubular letters and a lofty waist line. Bellota Text sits above it, commanding and open-shaped, with a lower, moderate lowercase that gives the page two distinct heights.
gen-gf-bellota-text-work-sans: Bellota Text brings open, unshaded letters and a commanding presence. Beside Work Sans, whose lowercase rises noticeably higher, the pair's strongest quality is how clearly its two lowercase heights differ.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-epilogue: Expressive and a little stretched out, Bruno Ace lets each character take its own beat along a ruler-straight line. And Epilogue answers with curvy, wire-thin letters in a lowercase that stands high, so the display and body feel built from different ideas.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans has a sturdy, large-looking lowercase. Bruno Ace is best at drawing a ruler-straight line with one unbroken weight, while Merriweather Sans is best at opening its e clearly to the right.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-supreme: Crisp, geometric, slightly mechanical. Bruno Ace keeps its counters connected to the outside, and Supreme follows with a dense, heavy-looking band of letters held open, which should read steadily over a full page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-orbit: Spaced-out and ruler-straight, with a futuristic feel. Bruno Ace keeps one constant line width and open counters, so it works best as a display heading, while Orbit's floating rope-like characters stay in the background.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-montserrat: Bruno Ace is a display face with a ruler-drawn line and a lingering, one-character-per-beat rhythm, set above Montserrat's generous curves. It belongs on headings, where that stretched pacing can be seen.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-switzer: Bruno Ace draws every line ruler-straight, with counters that stay connected to the outside. Switzer, a Swiss sans of wire-like tubular letters and c tips that never close in, keeps a longer stretch of text moving smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-work-sans: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace excels at an unbroken, ruler-drawn line with open counters and a lingering rhythm. Work Sans excels at the body role, its high mean line and c tips that never close making text feel modern.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-epilogue: Expressive from the first glance, Bruno Ace SC spreads open-apertured letters along the line like beads on a long thread, without any calligraphic thinning. Epilogue's curvy, wire-like monoline lowercase does the reading.
